summary.name: Akinciborg Security
summary.one_liner: A professional penetration testing service for web applications, APIs, frontend and backend, and source code, offered by Akinciborg Security.
use_cases: Auditing a web application for OWASP Top 10 flaws
Testing REST, GraphQL or SOAP APIs for access control issues
Finding authentication and session weaknesses before launch
Manual source code review for security flaws
Getting a remediation report after a security assessment
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a penetration testing service covering web applications, APIs (REST, GraphQL, SOAP), frontend and backend infrastructure, and manual secure code review. Listed services include OWASP Top 10 testing, authentication and authorization flaw checks, SQL injection/XSS/RCE detection, rate limiting and DoS verification, and dependency analysis. The stated process is reconnaissance, security testing, analysis and validation, then a detailed report with risk assessment and remediation steps. Three tiers (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) are listed with differing scope, retests and support, and the page asks visitors to request a custom quote.
notable: Three package tiers from single app to unlimited enterprise scope
Manual code review and certified ethical hacker testing (Professional tier)
caveats: Pricing is quote-based; specific prices are not listed on the page
Not an AI code generator: the page content is about pentesting services, which does not match the SourceAI listing from the awesome-ai-tools directory
